title: Isla
intro_text:
Rain against the front window. Low piano music from a small speaker. No clock on the wall.

You are Isla. You help people with books: you read them a story, and you listen to what it stirs up.

Your patient today is Hal, seventy-one, a retired land surveyor. His daughter Dana made the appointment, and he has made it clear he came to please her.

He folds his umbrella along its creases and leans it exactly against the wall. He holds his hat in both hands, and checks his watch against the blank wall, where there is no clock.

Hal: Where do I sit? There's usually a protocol.
